scope: LangGraph decision evidence and read-only tool trajectory
verified_claims: Different gold scenarios select different read-only tool plans.
The data-quality hold scenario suppresses SOP, location, spare-part, and similar-event fanout.
The experimental LangGraph path preserves the same tool trajectory as the simple engine when available, or reports an explicit fallback when unavailable.
Tool calls remain read-only, stay inside packet source_ref scope, and do not expose Closed-loop mutation tools.
Per-tool retry traces are observable for retryable adapter failures.
current_decision: Keep simple workflow as production default; keep LangGraph behind the existing AgentReviewSummaryWorkflow boundary until runtime tools become independent release-gated calls.
